description:
Order one item: beer 0, sponsor 300, report 500, listing copy 900 EUR cents.

        Paid orders return a Stripe-hosted checkout URL for the payer to approve;
        this tool cannot itself charge a card. Use public_credit only for explicit
        opt-in sponsor display. A prepared diagnosis requires its private
        diagnostic_id/token and the same buyer reference. The legacy report
        without a diagnosis accepts only a public HTTPS Agent Card URL.
        Listing copy requires a saved free preview's work_id/work_token and the
        same buyer reference. It purchases the prepared AI draft, not future work.
        Public buyer identity is self-declared. Never provide card details, secret
        keys, or private endpoint URLs. Save the private receipt token.
name: place_order
